memories.memory: I rent a small workshop apartment on the second floor at 18 Vezna Street in the fictional town of Novy Borik, where I keep my welding tools and spare parts.
My mobile number is written in my work notebook as the fictional contact 555-0147 so customers can reach me about repair jobs.
I was born in October 1963 and still use my full legal name, Tomas Horvat, on contracts for metalworking projects.
For the past nine years I have worked as an independent metal fabricator, mainly taking repair orders from three local construction companies.
My former employer kept my personnel file under the synthetic worker reference WH-64291, which I needed when applying for a pension statement last winter.
My daughter Elena lives with her husband in another city, and I usually send her about 180 euros each month to help with their mortgage.
After a dispute over unpaid overtime, I gave up my old workshop position in June 2021 and registered a sole-trader business under the fictional name Horvat Steel Repairs.
